hard_rules: classical domicile table is limited to Sun Moon Mercury Venus Mars Jupiter Saturn
classical exaltation table is limited to Sun Moon Mercury Venus Mars Jupiter Saturn
detriment is derived only as the sign opposite a classical domicile
fall is derived only as the sign opposite a classical exaltation
multiple simultaneous statuses are preserved instead of collapsed
Mercury in Virgo may be both domicile and exaltation
Mercury in Pisces may be both detriment and fall
outer planets and lunar nodes receive no invented classical dignity
